INSERT INTO ai_agent_working_memory_message ( session_id, memory_scope, turn_id, request_id, origin_message_key, run_id, seq_no, role, content, reasoning_content, tool_call_id, tool_calls_json, base64_image, message_kind, visibility, token_estimate, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES
( #{record.sessionId}, #{record.memoryScope}, #{record.turnId}, #{record.requestId}, #{record.originMessageKey}, #{record.runId}, #{record.seqNo}, #{record.role}, #{record.content}, #{record.reasoningContent}, #{record.toolCallId}, #{record.toolCallsJson}, #{record.base64Image}, #{record.messageKind}, #{record.visibility}, #{record.tokenEstimate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON m.turn_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.turn_seq ASC, m.seq_no ASC
mapper.sql: m.id, m.session_id, m.memory_scope, m.turn_id, m.request_id, m.origin_message_key, m.run_id, t.turn_seq, m.seq_no, m.role, m.content, m.reasoning_content, m.tool_call_id, m.tool_calls_json, m.message_kind, t.status AS turn_status
mapper.select:
SELECT , MATCH(m.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS search_score FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON m.turn_id = t.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND m.memory_scope = 'main' AND m.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0
AND MATCH(m.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY search_score DESC, t.turn_seq DESC, m.seq_no DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , MATCH(m.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS search_score FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON m.turn_id = t.id INNER JOIN ai_agent_dialogue_session s ON s.session_id = m.session_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE s.visitor_id = #{visitorId} AND m.memory_scope = 'main' AND m.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0
AND MATCH(m.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY search_score DESC, t.create_time DESC, t.turn_seq DESC, m.seq_no DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON m.turn_id = t.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND m.memory_scope = 'main' AND m.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0
AND (LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(m.content, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) LIKE LOWER(CONVERT(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) OR LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(m.tool_calls_json, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) LIKE LOWER(CONVERT(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)) ORDER BY t.turn_seq DESC, m.seq_no DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON m.turn_id = t.id INNER JOIN ai_agent_dialogue_session s ON s.session_id = m.session_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE s.visitor_id = #{visitorId} AND m.memory_scope = 'main' AND m.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0
AND (LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(m.content, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) LIKE LOWER(CONVERT(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) OR LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(m.tool_calls_json, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) LIKE LOWER(CONVERT(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)) ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.turn_seq DESC, m.seq_no DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON m.turn_id = t.id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND m.memory_scope = 'main' AND m.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.turn_seq ASC, m.seq_no ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, visitor_id AS visitorId, title AS title, latest_query_text AS latestQueryText, latest_summary_text AS latestSummaryText, started_at AS startedAt, last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message wm INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn wt ON wt.id = wm.turn_id WHERE wm.session_id = s.session_id AND wm.memory_scope = 'main' AND wm.deleted = 0 AND wt.deleted = 0) AS messageCount FROM ai_agent_dialogue_session s WHERE deleted = 0 AND (#{visitorId} IS NULL OR visitor_id = #{visitorId}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message wm INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn wt ON wt.id = wm.turn_id WHERE wm.session_id = s.session_id AND wm.memory_scope = 'main' AND wm.deleted = 0 AND wt.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_active_at, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, visitor_id AS visitorId, title AS title, started_at AS startedAt, last_active_at AS lastActiveAt FROM ai_agent_dialogue_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
